title: The Vanished Marshmallow Stick Trophy
intro: The campground's prized golden lantern has disappeared from the picnic table just before the campfire awards.

suspects.name: Milo
suspects.line: I was roasting marshmallows the whole time. Ask anyone.

suspects.name: Theo
suspects.line: I was fast asleep in my tent, honest.

suspects.name: Rosa
suspects.line: Lantern? I haven't touched a lantern all week.

suspects.name: Otto
suspects.line: I went for a walk to clear my head, that's all.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: I was only out looking for my lost flip-flop.

clues.text: Muddy footprints lead away from the table, but they are not from a green poncho wearer, whose boots were spotless all evening.
A small flashlight beam was spotted bobbing toward the woods; the one carrying a flashlight is the lantern's likely taker.
A striped sweater hangs dry on the line, so its owner was never out on the damp grass chasing the lantern.
Someone who was lingering by the fire pit at the lantern's vanishing time has a solid alibi, since they were roasting marshmallows the whole while.
